hints.title: Circular Path Directions
hints.text: Consider the two possible paths between any two houses: clockwise forward travel and counter-clockwise backward travel.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Cost Query
hints.text: Precompute prefix sums for clockwise and counter-clockwise traversal costs to evaluate both directions in constant time.

hints.title: Sequential Greedy Choice
hints.text: For each consecutive target query, take the minimum of the forward cost and backward wrap-around cost, updating the current position.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minTotalTime(self, forward: List[int], backward: List[int], queries: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(forward)
        sum_b = sum(backward)
        ans = 0
        pos = 0
        prefixF = [0] * (n + 1)
        prefixB = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n):
            prefixF[i + 1] = prefixF[i] + forward[i]
            prefixB[i] = (0 if i == 0 else prefixB[i - 1]) + backward[i]

        for q in queries:
            r = (prefixF[n] if q < pos else 0) + prefixF[q] - prefixF[pos]
            l = (sum_b if q > pos else 0) + prefixB[pos] - prefixB[q]
            ans += min(l, r)
            pos = q
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Linear scan with precomputed prefix arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating circular steps step-by-step takes O(n * q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary prefix tables allow O(1) interval sum evaluation per query.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle modular wrap-around distance arithmetic correctly.
